Generated Narrative: CodeSystem medication-admin-category

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medication-admin-category defines the following codes:

Code Display Definition
inpatient Inpatient Includes administrations for medications to be administered or consumed in an inpatient or acute care setting.
outpatient Outpatient Includes administrations for medications to be administered or consumed in an outpatient setting (for example, Emergency Department, Outpatient Clinic, Outpatient Surgery, Doctor's office).
community Community Includes administrations for medications to be administered or consumed by the patient in their home (this would include long term care or nursing homes, hospices, etc.).
discharge Discharge Includes administrations for medications created when the patient is being released from a facility.
